name: Azzinoth's Assault extends Inner Demon's duration (#4664)
contract: Azzinoth's Assault (803472) tooltip reads (conditional on Inner Demon): 'Extends the duration of Inner Demon by $/1000;803089s1 sec.' 803472's own DBC effects only trigger its two weapon hits (520262, 572585); 803089 (EffectMiscValue 804216 = Inner Demon, EffectBasePoints 2999 + DieSides 1 = 3000ms, EffectBonusMultiplier 0.4 = AP scaling) was never cast by 803472 anywhere, and even if it had been, SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_AURA_DURATION (177) had no registered handler in src/server/coa for Felsworn, unlike the same custom effect on Reaper/Witch Hunter/Venomancer. The fix (a) casts 803089 from felsworn_casts::OnSpellHitResult when 803472 lands on a hostile target while Inner Demon is active, and (b) registers a SpellEffectFn on 803089's EFFECT_0 (following the exact Reaper/Venomancer pattern) that calls AscensionFelsworn::Extend, the same helper already used for Inner Demon's stack-based duration, with GetEffectValue() - a new FelswornCoefficients row (803089, effect 0, ap 0.4) feeds the AP scaling through the same ModifySpellEffectBaseValue hook the class already uses for every other AP/SP-scaled effect, so GetEffectValue() resolves the DBC's full 3000ms-plus-AP formula. Inner Demon's own max duration is 5000ms per Felfury stack (OnCalcMaxDuration); fixturing 2 Felfury before casting Inner Demon gives a known 10000ms baseline duration to extend from.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Fixture 2 Felfury so Inner Demon's max duration is a known 10000ms
SETUP: Inner Demon is active at the 2-stack duration
DISCRIMINATING: Azzinoth's Assault extends Inner Demon by at least the DBC's 3000ms base
